name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.33.1: macOS positive test fixtures canonicalize temporary roots because /var can resolve to /private/var; strict runtime linked-parent guards remain unchanged. The v0.33.0 candidate was not published after macOS CI failed. Published baseline remains v0.32.0. Feature scope: offline state/dependency revision and evidence-insufficiency evaluations use independently authored synthetic fixtures and digest-bound structured observation replay. Opt-in check-support --row-references exports every parsed row and an audit population; --bind-subject adds conservative same-physical-line subject/value observations separately from existing warnings and support decisions. These diagnostics do not verify facts or semantic attribution. Existing flags-off output is unchanged in the tested comparisons. checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. Certificate regeneration runs the harmless replay. No model/network call, default hook change or automatic vault migration is added.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
